Running command: cd /tmp && cat > fuzz.py << 'EOF'
import subprocess, os, itertools, sys

# Try various inputs with 3 spaces at the end, in various contexts
candidates = []
# fenced code not closed, ending with 3 spaces
for prefix in ['```\n', '~~~\n', '```\n```\n', '```\n\n', '```\n   \n', '```\n  \n']:
    candidates.append(prefix + '   ')
    candidates.append(prefix + '   \n')
# list items
for marker in ['- ', '* ', '+ ', '1. ', '1) ']:
    candidates.append(marker + '   ')
    candidates.append(marker + '   \n')
# blockquote
candidates.append('>    ')
candidates.append('>    \n')
# plain
candidates.append('   ')
candidates.append('    ')
candidates.append('   \n')
# with trailing content after
candidates.append('```\n   \n```')
candidates.append('```\n   \n```\n')
candidates.append('-    \n-    ')
candidates.append('-    \n-    \n')

for i, c in enumerate(candidates):
    with open('/tmp/fz_input.bin','wb') as f:
        f.write(c.encode())
    r = subprocess.run(['/tmp/hoedown_fuzzer_asan','/tmp/fz_input.bin'], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
    out = r.stdout + r.stderr
    if b'ERROR: AddressSanitizer' in out or r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"CRASH on candidate {i}: {c!r} rc={r.returncode}")
        print(out.decode(errors='replace')[:2000])
        break
else:
    print("No crash found in", len(candidates), "candidates")
EOF
python3 fuzz.py
